Why is hit in the testicles so painful?

The nerve innervation is provided by Spermatic Plexus. The testes are embryologically derived from the same level as the kidneys and, therefore, share a common level of innervation, that being the T10-L1 level for pain conduction and T10-L2 for sympathetic innervation.

In other words, the innervation is the same type as for internal organs, not for external body. For women: getting hit there is like if somebody opened your abdominal cavity and punched you there without anaesthetic. If you are ever unlucky to have kidney problems, you may experience the very same pain guys feel when hit to the testicles, compliments of the same nerve complex.

Some source: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC1249277/

Subjectively, strange feeling about hit in the testicles is that I do not feel the pain in the place of the hit, but towards two sides of the pelvis, where ovaries should be.
